statement: Skilling food (chopping and mining food) can be equipped in party dungeons and does not get consumed.
Rank 5 trait: plus 3 base damage.
Rank 10 trait: start each dungeon run with two RNG items; sugar rush or handy ice pick both viable.
Rank 50 trait: each green item gives plus 1 base damage; take it over drop chance since drop chance isn't needed here.
Rank 20 trait is a free choice: credits or flurbos.
Rank 25 trait: enhancers drop from mobs instead of equipment 25% more; good for RNG voucher drops late game.
Rank 30 trait: shop prices of RNG items scale 15% slower; very important as time is tight and you want max RNG items.
Rank 35 trait: higher rarity RNG items 25% more likely; feeds into the rank 15 trait.
Rank 40 traits currently do not work the same as rank 50; treat it as if you are rank 40.
Max out base damage and total damage percent before attempting third Galaxias because you rely on horn of the fool.
Cards differ per player but aim for the stats: Rage Snake Step for total damage percent.
Laszlo gives RNG item rarity which increases chance of horn of the fool and RNG voucher drops.
Beefy gives money percent; more money means more RNG items.
Caustic Galaxies gives total damage percent but most people lack it; MP regen is an alternative.
Grand Frogger gives starting with an extra RNG item and can be swapped out after the start of the dungeon.
Cactopunk for boss damage percent and King Frog for base damage; cards can be swapped around.
No grumble build for this party dungeon; the damage needed outscales grumble by an insane amount.
The run is 100 percent a horn of the fool run; could be done with RNG voucher but that is RNG based.

RNG item priority: sharp eye, sugar rush, handy ice pick, stardew drop, boss skull, sucker punch, blood vial, can of varnish, sneaky cap, dead book, single cut, RNG voucher, genesis fear, super soda, coin flip.
Super soda gives an extra sugar rush and mana percent back per hit.
Coin flip has a chance of giving an orange legendary RNG item or four grey RNG items: horn of the fool and one ninja smoke.
Dungeon has two phases: task phase doing as many tasks as possible and boss rush phase ignoring tasks and rushing bosses one two and three.
In task phase do all tasks but skip some or get them done ahead of time; timing of purchases is essential.
For the distance-covered task click back and forth on the bottom platform and purchase RNG items while doing so.
Climbing down the ice rope does not count as distance covered.
Another good time to purchase RNG items is while chopping the wispy tree for three logs.
Avoid killing ice guards as much as possible because they are also a task.
When running past the fish pond click it to try for an instant reel of a jellyfish or goldfish.
You have an invisible temporary inventory that can be used to your advantage.
Do not do the fishing task when it prompts since it is a complete time waster; only fish on rounds if you get instant reels.
While the fishing task is active farm wispy lumber and frostdoor from mining node to create a domino effect via temporary storage.
Mining and chopping tasks always come in stacks of three so having six or nine of each in temporary storage is massive.
Jellyfish and goldfish are also part of the temporary storage.
While mining nodes use your spells to get extra kills since skills do not break you from skilling.
Penguin and bunny tasks spawn in specific map places; unexpected spots are pretty rare.
Bunny spawns mostly on the right side next to the ice guards before the neptunes or on the neptunes platform; rarely by thurmeisters or beside the boss.
Penguin usually spawns on the left side of the map at mammoose or the platform above it.
Continue the task phase until the timer hits 4 minutes 30 seconds; then the boss rush phase starts.
Basement shop buy order: more mobs, 50 damage, 25 movement speed, 2x guard damage, 1.5x carb damage, then the rest into RNG items.
Do not skip guard damage upgrades; you need the damage especially for the very tanky third boss and faster kills save boss time.
In boss rush follow the arrows on the map for the shortest distance to each boss.
The left guard at the very top is always weaker than the right guard before the boss.
You must kill at least one top guard or the boss gets a defense buff making him unkillable.
With ninja smoke let a mammoth hit you under the rope to proc it and use the invincibility frames to walk past the guard without being one shot.
Insta-rez could do the same trick but you only get one a day and no style points.
Trick saves little time at second boss guard but roughly 10 to 30 seconds at the third boss guard.
If done right you should notice the domino effect completing tasks without doing anything; this is ideal.
At third boss without vouchers buy accessory enhancements for total damage percent and armor for boss damage percent.
With vouchers sell the enhancers to get more RNG items and hit as hard as possible.
By the third boss sneaky cap should have procced and quirky chan? should be pretty high.
You need about 30k damage per hit to defeat the third Galaxias.
